text:
Maya (oncall): paging — canary deploy to us-west6 just started throwing decrypt errors and 502s. seeing KMS AccessDenied in logs. tagging @Jamal and @Claire. :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4923 - canary decrypt errors after config flip. Pager routed to oncall.
Jamal (eng-sre): on it, grabbing logs. any recent secret/env changes in that canary?
Claire (deploy): yes — flipped env FLAG_ACCESS_V2=true and rotated a key alias as part of the rollout (staging->prod alias swap). did a small canary (10%).
Priya (prodops): initial metrics: 10% of requests in us-west6 for /v1/generate are 502 or 500 with 5xx spike, overall error budget impact ~0.8%.
Jamal (eng-sre): logs show repeated error: `kms:Decrypt AccessDenied for arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-rotated`
Jamal (eng-sre): stack trace snippet:
```
2026-03-17T15:22:03Z service error: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/redwood-canary-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-rotated
at kmsClient.Decrypt
```
Claire (deploy): hmm — the canary role should have had the updated key ARN in the IAM policy. I may have missed updating the assume-role policy when alias changed.
Victor (support): any customer-facing impact? have we opened tickets?
Priya (prodops): no escalations yet, but a few webhooks retried. Affected customers: a handful of mid-tier tenants in us-west region (we have IDs).
Jamal (eng-sre): immediate mitigation options: 1) kill the feature flag to stop new requests hitting V2 path, 2) rollback the canary to previous env, 3) patch IAM to grant kms:Decrypt to the canary role for the new key. fastest to reduce customer errors is kill-switch + rollback.
Claire (deploy): I can flip the flag now. toggling `FLAG_ACCESS_V2=false` in LaunchDarkly for us-west6 only.
Claire (deploy): toggled. confirm?
Maya (oncall): traffic to V2 in us-west dropped to 0. errors falling. good.
deploy-bot: Rollout: canary rollback triggered by Claire at 15:26 UTC. Rolling back to image sha: a1b2c3 previous.
Jamal (eng-sre): after rollback errors dropped to baseline. monitoring for five more minutes.
Priya (prodops): customer impact summary for incident report: ~2,400 requests failed over 12 minutes, peak error rate 4.1% for us-west6, no SLA breaches yet but close for one mid-market customer.
Victor (support): I'll pre-compose a note for affected customers and queue CS triage. no high-priority pages.
Jamal (eng-sre): root cause: env alias/key rotation performed but IAM role used by canary pods did not get updated permissions for the new key ARN — permission drift during deploy.
Claire (deploy): I triggered the alias swap and rollout from the same job; I missed the policy step that adds the new key ARN to `redwood-canary-role`. I'll add a checklist entry to the deploy job.
Maya (oncall): mitigation done (kill-switch + rollback). follow-ups: (1) patch IAM policy for `redwood-canary-role` to include the new key ARN, (2) add automated pre-deploy check that verifies canary role has kms:Decrypt on all target key ARNs, (3) postmortem and customer note.
Jamal (eng-sre): creating quick remediation PR to attach the policy change to IaC and will run canary role validation script: `./scripts/check_kms_perms --role redwood-canary-role --keys arn:aws:kms:...`
Jamal (eng-sre): PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/519 - adds key ARN, adds unit test.
Claire (deploy): adding pre-deploy gating to the pipeline: fail if `check_kms_perms` fails. will also include a one-line reminder in the deploy job UI.
Priya (prodops): logging incident type as "deploy-config-permission-drift" and severity P2. scheduling postmortem for tomorrow EOD.
Maya (oncall): handing over to Jamal for remediation and follow-up; I'm out after 30m. @Jamal pls coordinate with Claire and Prod for the postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-4923 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Jamal (eng-sre): monitoring window passed, metrics stable. I'll finish the remediation PR and keep the canary blocked until policy check is in place.
Victor (support): customer note ready, will send after postmortem outcomes.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-4923 resolved at 15:42 UTC.
Maya (oncall): thanks team — good catch.
Claire (deploy): sorry about the miss, will push checklist and pipeline change today.
Jamal (eng-sre): filing final incident report with timeline + dpatch link to PR.
Priya (prodops): closing ops checklist.
Victor (support): closing customer outreach draft after final sign-off.
